Welcome to your coastal oasis on 30A – where every moment feels like a breeze! Take our word for it – you're stepping into a dreamy landscape of blues and whites. Nestled in the serene surroundings of Grande Pointe community, this 4-bed, 4.5-bath home offers the perfect retreat for your beach getaway. With sleeping arrangements for up to 10 guests (plus every room is an en suite!) and an open living and dining concept, you'll feel right at home from the moment you arrive.
⭐Highlights:
- Beach access is one of the best on 30A! Inlet Beach Regional is the biggest public beach access on 30A and offers lifeguards, restrooms, outdoor showers, and is ADA accessible. It also offers the most parking of any public beach access point and has plenty of room!
- Quick golf cart ride, 15 min walk, or easy 10 min bike ride to Inlet Beach Regional OR Phillips Inlet Beach Access Point. Both great options!
- 4 complimentary bikes to cruise to the beach, or along The Timpoochee Trail. This will take you the all the way down 30A to explore different neighborhoods!
- 5 min walk to community lake and dock
- 2 min walk to community pool access
- 5 min drive to 30Avenue with shops, restaurants, and activities.
- Open concept living
- Sleeps 10! All rooms have en suite bathrooms
- 4 complimentary beach chairs and towels
-Outdoor grill
- Washer and dryer
- ⭐️ NEW ⭐️ Fun perks now available for Kalos' guests. Now offering, 20% off all Sculpt Studio classes at the Big Chill. Contact us for details!

⭐Step Inside ~
You'll enter into the open concept living; living room, dining, and kitchen open so that all the family can gather together. The living room is decked out with shag rugs and pillows-- all the coziness you need after a long day at the beach, or first thing in the morning with a cup of joe.

Next, step into our stainless-steel KitchenAid-equipped kitchen, where you'll find everything you need to whip up a delicious meal for your family and friends. From the plush dining room seating for 6 to the additional seats at the kitchen island (3 more!), there's plenty of room for everyone to gather and enjoy a meal together.

But the real highlight? Our wet bar and wine fridge – perfect for mixing up your favorite cocktails or enjoying a glass of wine as you unwind after a day at the beach. And speaking of the beach, with beach access less than a mile away, you're just a short stroll or ride from sinking your toes into the soft sand and soaking up the Florida sunshine.

After a day of sun and surf, retreat to one of our luxurious bedrooms, each with its own en suite bathroom and smart TV. With exposed brick and special ceiling details, every room is designed for comfort and relaxation. And for the kids, our bunk room comes complete with a sitting area for play and games – ensuring fun for the whole family!


⭐Where you'll sleep:
Primary bedroom (located on first floor): Queen bed with en suite walk in shower
Guest room: (located on second floor): King bed with en suite walk in shower
Guest room: (located on second floor): King bed with en suite walk in shower
Bunk room: (located on second floor): 2 twin bunk beds with en suite bath and shower Nothing says 'home away from home' like firing up the grill and relaxing with bbq, burgers, or hot dogs. Perfect escape at the end of a sun-filled day.

⭐Location:
- Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access - The Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access, which is the largest public beach access in Walton County, is conveniently located just 0.9 miles away and can be easily reached by walking or biking. This beach access offers several amenities such as public restrooms, outdoor showers, ample parking space, and lifeguard services during the season.
- Phillips Inlet Beach Access - (0.6 miles away) You can cross over HWY 98 on 'N Walton Lakeshore Drive', and that runs you right in to the beach access. (No public parking)
- Lupine Beach Access - (0.9 miles away) You can cross over HWY 98 on 'N Walton Lakeshore Drive', and that runs you right into the beach access at Phillips. Lupine is located at the end of 'Walton Magnolia Ln'. (No public parking)
And don't forget to check out Bruno's for pizza and Donut hole for coffee and donuts!

With beach access, pool access, and a calming home to come back to, it's impossible to have a bad day! Pack your bags and grab your flip flops, we'd love to host you!

To note:
- Parking: There is parking for 1 car in the garage and 2 cars in the driveway. Street parking in not permitted.
- The word is out! 30A is one of Florida's best vacation spots. Unfortunately, more visitors means less parking options. Additional parking spaces are the responsibility of the renter. We recommend looking into nearby storage facilities who offer long term parking options in their lots.
- Minimum age to rent the home is 23.
- We love our furry friends, and they need a vacation too! We allow dogs that are under 20 lbs and non- shedding. If your pup fits that criteria, we'd love for you to bring them along. A one-time, non-refundable pet fee of $150 + tax will be added to your reservation. Thank you for understanding!
- Vacation disruptions can be a bummer. While it doesn't happen often, you may experience issues with Wi-Fi or construction on 30A. We are not responsible for any disruptions to the Wi-Fi service or any construction that may affect your experience. Please note that such occurrences are beyond our control, and we appreciate your understanding and patience in these matters.

description: Located in Panama City Beach, this vacation home is near a water park and on a lake. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Kayaking, snorkeling, and parasailing offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with hiking nearby.
